page.title: World University Rankings 2027
page.body:
Explore the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027 below. Trusted worldwide by students, academics, governments and industry experts, the list of the best universities in the world includes 2,297 institutions from 118 countries and territories. Read the full methodology here.

University rankings 2027: highlights

  • University of Oxford is number one for record 11th consecutive year
  • China’s Tsinghua University rises to number 11, overtaking Switzerland’s ETH Zurich
  • Asia is ahead of continental Europe for the first time
  • National University of Singapore (NUS) moves into top 15
  • Three Asian universities in top 15 for the first time
